summary: Tesla car experience website with hero video slides, animated features, parallax sections, interactive 3D gallery, scroll-triggered car animations, video showcase, car listing/sales with pricing, user authentication (signup/login), admin page for customer support and management, and payment integration for purchasing Tesla vehicles
architectural_notes: Single-page HTML application with embedded CSS and JavaScript
Video-centric design with autoplay hero slides rotating every 8 seconds
Scroll-based animations using intersection observer pattern
CSS 3D transforms for gallery hover effects
Sticky header with backdrop blur effect
User authentication flow with signup/login pages
Admin dashboard for customer support and order management
E-commerce functionality for car sales with pricing display
Payment processing integration for vehicle purchases

existing_features.title: Implement a sticky header with logo 'ElectricCar' and navigation links (Home, Features, Gallery, Video) that remains at the top on scroll with a semi-transparent black background and backdrop blur effect

Create a full-screen hero section with three rotating video background slides that automatically fade between each other every 8 seconds, each displaying a different heading ('Electric Speed', 'Autopilot Innovation', 'Design That Inspires') and a call-to-action button centered over the video

Build a features section with three feature cards (Fast Acceleration, Autopilot, Long Range) that appear with a fade-up animation when scrolled into view, each displaying an image, heading, and description on a dark background
Implement a parallax section with fixed background image and centered text 'Innovation Meets Design' that creates a depth effect when scrolling
Create a scroll-triggered car animation where a car image moves horizontally across the screen from left to right as the user scrolls down the page
Build an interactive 3D gallery section displaying three car images that apply 3D rotation and scale transforms on hover to create a depth effect
Implement a video showcase section with heading 'Watch the Car in Action' and an embedded video player that fades up when scrolled into view
Add a footer with centered copyright text '© 2026 Electric Car Company. All rights reserved.' on a dark background
Apply a modern, sleek visual theme with black background, white text, cyan accent color (#00e0ff), smooth scroll behavior, and consistent Roboto font family throughout the application

Generate and render all required images as static assets in frontend/public/assets/generated including hero video placeholders, feature images, parallax background, scrolling car, gallery images, and video thumbnail
Update the header logo text from 'ElectricCar' to 'Tesla' in the Header component
Update all hero section slide headings to Tesla-specific messaging: 'Ludicrous Speed', 'Full Self-Driving', 'Revolutionary Design'
Update the footer copyright text from '© 2026 Electric Car Company. All rights reserved.' to '© 2026 Tesla, Inc. All rights reserved.'
Update the document title in index.html from 'Electric Car Experience' to 'Tesla Experience'
Create a Tesla models listing page displaying available Tesla vehicles for sale with model names, specifications, and pricing information
Create an admin page for customer support and management with sections for viewing customer inquiries, managing orders, and monitoring inventory
Create a payment flow page where users can purchase Tesla vehicles by selecting a car, entering payment details, and completing the transaction
Create a user signup page with Internet Identity integration allowing users to register for an account
Create a user login page with Internet Identity integration for existing users to authenticate
Update the header navigation to include new links for Cars, Admin (for authenticated admins), Login/Signup (for unauthenticated users), and User Profile (for authenticated users)
Fix the signup page to properly register new users with Internet Identity authentication and create user profiles in the backend
